$comment: Domain Map SSOT Template. Copied as docs/features/domain-map.json. Single source of truth for domain boundary definitions (domains) + feature assignment registry (features). Registered by feature-architect when creating features (copied from this template if file doesn't exist), and synchronized with CONTEXT.json by feature-status-sync. Consulted obligatorily during feature-pilot Phase 0 Domain Placement. domains[].aliases[] is optional — maps DOMAIN-MODEL bounded_contexts[] names to domain vocabulary, activating domain-boundary-coherence BC name checks when 1+ domains declare it (no impact if unused).

domains.name: Example Domain
domains.responsibility: Describe responsibilities owned by this domain in 1-2 sentences (e.g., user authentication, sessions, workspace membership)
